info.description: OmniLogin local HTTP API. Manages browser profiles, proxies, groups, automation workflows, and AI Apps. The same server also exposes a Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint at POST /mcp for AI agents (Claude, Antigravity, Cursor, etc.).
info.title: Omnilogin Local API

parameters.name: remote_debug_port
parameters.description: Fixed debug port to remote by driver like selenium

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Browser windows scale percent. Example open browser with scale 50%: ?scale=50

parameters.name: headless
parameters.description: Open browser without showing windows. Example: ?headless=true

parameters.name: addition_args
parameters.description: Additional args to pass when open chrome. You can pass multiple of this param. Example: ?addition_args=[arg1]&addition_args=[arg2]

parameters.name: launch_bridge
parameters.description: Start an OmniBridge automation server for this profile. When true, the response includes bridge_url for connecting via @omnilogin/sdk. Example: ?launch_bridge=true

parameters.name: show_virtual_mouse
parameters.description: Show the virtual mouse overlay for the launched browser. Useful when you want cursor movement to stay visible while using OmniBridge or MCP. Example: ?show_virtual_mouse=true

parameters.name: humanize_mouse
parameters.description: Enable humanized mouse movement for the launched browser. OmniBridge launch defaults this to true when the query is omitted. Example: ?humanize_mouse=false

bridge_url.description: WebSocket URL for OmniBridge automation connection. Only present when launch_bridge=true. Connect using @omnilogin/sdk OmniClient.

post.description: Run an app in `debug` mode against a single profile (good for iterating on the script) or in `batch` mode using the app's saved runner config.

mode.description: `debug` runs once against `profileId` (or `app.profileId`). Anything else runs the saved batch (`runBatch`).

profileId.description: Profile to run against in `debug` mode. Falls back to `app.profileId` if omitted.

inputValues.description: Values for the app's declared input parameters.

400.description: Profile ID is required for debug mode

404.description: AI App or profile not found

parameters.description: AI App ID. Currently the runner is process-global, so any app id is accepted; the call stops whatever is running.

get.description: Triggers IPv6 rotation for the given proxy. Only works for proxies whose host is on the local IPv6 pool managed by OmniLogin.

parameters.name: proxyId
parameters.description: ID of the IPv6-pool proxy to rotate.

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint implementing the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io). Used by external AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity) to drive OmniLogin: list/create profiles, launch browsers, automate pages, etc. Authenticated by the same session check as the rest of the API. Tool surface can be narrowed via `?categories=cat1,cat2` (cat names: profile, group, proxy, browser, automation, ipv6, navigate, interact, read, input, tab, context, wait, evaluate, omni, page).

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Comma-separated category allowlist for `tools/list`. Omit to expose all tools.

202.description: Accepted (no response payload, e.g. for notifications).

has_user.description: true if at least one of transactions or new_invites has data

transactions.description: Present when type=transactions or type not provided. null if no match

new_invites.description: Present when type=new_invites or type not provided. null if no match

renderer.example: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-27.21.14.5671)

timezone.description: true: Generate corresponding timezone based on IP. otherwise, use tzValue as timezone

tzValue.description: Apply when timezone=false. Name of timezone. Leave it empty string if you want to use local timezone

web_rtc.description:
Web RTC options:
 * `automatic` - WebRTC enabled. Public IP will be replaced by proxy IP and Local IP will be masked
 * `manual` - WebRTC enabled. Public IP will be replaced by IP which you entered and Local IP will be masked
 * `real` - WebRTC enabled. Your real IP address will be used
 * `disabled` - WebRTC is closed. Websites will detect that you close the WebRTC

public_ip.description: Required when web_rtc=manual. Otherwise it should be null

screen_resolution.example: Default select is empty. Can be a string like 800x600 or random

fonts.description: SystemDefault or Custom. Use system fonts or We will random a custom font list for you

lang.example: Empty string (''), 'auto', or 'en-US,en,es-US,st'. Notes: 'random' is not allow from this version

user_agent.description: Custom user-agent string. Defaults to empty (auto).

user_agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; Win64; x64; rv:47.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/47.0

script.description: Deno-compatible TypeScript script the app runs.

uiCode.description: Optional renderer UI code for the app's input panel.

profileId.description: Default profile used in debug mode. May be null if the app is intended for batch only.

inputValues.description: Default values for the app's declared input parameters.
